name: gatefold
title: Gatefold
description: A record rack: every product is a square 12-inch sleeve, its title in huge tight black capitals against one edge, white and flat orange by turns, with a round price sticker stuck on askew.

tokens.--font-display: the tight capitals: titles, headings, the shop's name, prices, the phone number
tokens.--font-text: body text and everything not in capitals or mono
tokens.--font-mono: small labels: menu, categories, sleeve notes, units, status, details, hours, dates, footer, code
tokens.--tracking-tight: how tightly the display capitals are set
tokens.--tracking-mono: letter spacing of the small mono capitals
tokens.--title-size: size of a sleeve title and the home page headline as a share of the sleeve's width; short ones are set larger
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, heavy rules, focus rings, the outline of the e-mail button
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dates, page numbers, the footer, everything on a sold-out sleeve
tokens.--color-accent: link underlines, list bullets, the rule beside a quotation
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules: table rows, details, opening hours, the news list, above the footer
tokens.--color-sleeve: the white sleeves, and the price sticker on an orange sleeve
tokens.--color-spot: orange sleeves, the sticker on a white sleeve, the product page sleeve, the gatefold front, the current menu item, the phone button
tokens.--color-sleeve-ink: type and keyline on sleeves, stickers and everything orange; the gatefold and photo outline (black in both schemes)
tokens.--color-press: the masthead spine and the inside of the gatefold
tokens.--color-press-ink: text on the masthead and inside the gatefold
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of text
tokens.--gap: space between sleeves in the rack
tokens.--keyline: width of the line round sleeves, stickers, the gatefold, a product photograph, the contact buttons
tokens.--rule: width of the heavy rules over liner notes, details, tables, the news list and the order card, and beside a quotation
tokens.--sticker: smallest diameter of a price sticker; a longer price makes it larger
tokens.--tilt: how far the price is turned on its sticker; alternate sleeves turn it the other way
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: around tags, under a small heading
tokens.--space-2: small gap: under labels, inside and between the contact buttons
tokens.--space-3: page gutter on small screens, the gap between a sleeve's title, its notes and its sticker
tokens.--space-5: large gap above the liner notes and the how-to-order card
